build_CosmosQA_dataset: build a CosmosQA dataset builder class that downloads train, validation, and test splits from CSV and JSONL files
create_CosmosQA_info: create a CosmosQA dataset info object with context, question, answer options, label, and id features
test_CosmosQA_split_generators: test the CosmosQA _split_generators method to download and return tfds split generators for train, validation, and test
review_CosmosQA_generate_examples: review the CosmosQA _generate_examples method that yields examples from CSV and JSONL file formats
summarize_CosmosQA_class: summarize the CosmosQA tfds builder class that provides commonsense reading comprehension dataset with multiple-choice questions
